abstract: The expression of proliferating cell nuclear antigen (PCNA) in human trophoblastic disease was assessed immunohistochemically in tissue from 29 spontaneous abortions, 33 partial moles, 40 complete moles and 23 choriocarcinomas using the monoclonal antibody PC10. PCNA immunoreactivity occurred predominantly in the cytotrophoblasts in each of the four types of tissues. Quantitative analysis showed that the choriocarcinoma group gave a statistically significant higher PCNA index than the other three. There was no significant difference between the groups of spontaneous abortion, partial or complete mole. Sixteen of the 73 patients with partial and complete moles developed persistent gestational trophoblastic disease and there was no significant difference between the patients requiring chemotherapy and those who did not. We conclude that choriocarcinoma has a significantly higher PCNA proliferative index whilst hydatidiform moles cannot be distinguished from abortions by such analysis. The PCNA index does not appear to be useful in predicting the progression of molar pregnancies to persistent trophoblastic diseases.
abstract_ja: 自然流産組織29例、部分胞状奇胎33例、完全胞状奇胎40例、絨毛癌23例を用いて、モノクローナル抗体PC10により増殖細胞核抗原（PCNA）の発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。PCNAの免疫反応性は、4群いずれの組織においても主に細胞栄養膜細胞に認められた。定量解析では、絨毛癌群は他の3群より統計学的に有意に高いPCNA指数を示した。流産、部分胞状奇胎、完全胞状奇胎の各群の間には有意差はなかった。部分胞状奇胎および完全胞状奇胎の患者73例中16例が持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患を発症したが、化学療法を必要とした患者と必要としなかった患者の間に有意差はなかった。以上より、絨毛癌のPCNA増殖指数は有意に高く、胞状奇胎は解析により流産と区別できないと結論した。PCNA指数は、奇胎妊娠の持続性栄養膜疾患への進行予測には有用ではないと考えられる。
